LanguageData.LP_Install_InfusedArm.label: install infused arm
LanguageData.LP_Install_InfusedArm.description: A prosthetic arm forged from steel and a little mithril, then infused with magic. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 115%. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Make_InfusedArm.label: forge infused arm
LanguageData.LP_Make_InfusedArm.description: Forge an infused arm at the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Install_InfusedLeg.label: install infused leg
LanguageData.LP_Install_InfusedLeg.description: A prosthetic leg forged from steel and a little mithril, then infused with magic. Replaces a whole leg, part efficiency 115%. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Make_InfusedLeg.label: forge infused leg
LanguageData.LP_Make_InfusedLeg.description: Forge an infused leg at the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Install_ColdIronArm.label: install cold iron arm
LanguageData.LP_Install_ColdIronArm.description: A prosthetic arm forged from tempered cold iron, always cold to the touch. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 125%; +30% melee damage against targets weak to cold iron (fey blood, elves, psycasters) and fiends. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Make_ColdIronArm.label: forge cold iron arm
LanguageData.LP_Make_ColdIronArm.description: Forge a cold iron arm at the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Install_MithralLeg.label: install mithril leg
LanguageData.LP_Install_MithralLeg.description: A mithril prosthetic leg so light it's almost weightless. Replaces a whole leg, part efficiency 130%; move speed penalties from worn apparel halved (most noticeable with heavy armor). Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Make_MithralLeg.label: forge mithril leg
LanguageData.LP_Make_MithralLeg.description: Forge a mithril leg at the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Install_AdamantArm.label: install adamantine arm
LanguageData.LP_Install_AdamantArm.description: A prosthetic arm forged from adamantine, almost unbreakable. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 140%; injuries on this arm -50%, melee armor penetration +25%. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Make_AdamantArm.label: forge adamantine arm
LanguageData.LP_Make_AdamantArm.description: Forge an adamantine arm at the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Install_ClockEye.label: install precision clockwork eye
LanguageData.LP_Install_ClockEye.description: A clockwork eye of mithril gears and jade lenses. Replaces one eye, part efficiency 125%; shooting accuracy +5%, no penalty in dim light. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Make_ClockEye.label: forge precision clockwork eye
LanguageData.LP_Make_ClockEye.description: Forge a precision clockwork eye at the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Install_MithralHeart.label: install mithril heart core
LanguageData.LP_Install_MithralHeart.description: A heart core of mithril and adamantine that beats steady and strong. Replaces the heart, part efficiency 130%; toxic buildup -50%, never gets heart disease again. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Make_MithralHeart.label: forge mithril heart core
LanguageData.LP_Make_MithralHeart.description: Forge a mithril heart core at the rune anvil.
LanguageData.LP_Make_IounBlank.label: make raw ioun stone
LanguageData.LP_Make_IounBlank.description: Make a raw ioun stone at the enchanting table from 20 mithril, 15 jade and 10 gold.
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Ioun_Str.label: set ioun skull stone: strength
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Ioun_Str.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Adventurer Strength +2 (applied after the ability cap, can exceed 20). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.

LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_HellHeart.label: install netherfire heart
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_HellHeart.descriptio: Netherfire replaces the heartbeat in the chest. Replaces the heart, part efficiency 120%; bleeding rate ×0.2. Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 800 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Craft_HellHeart.label: grow netherfire heart
LanguageData.LP_Craft_HellHeart.description: Grow a netherfire heart from 800 fresh raw meat and 150 silver.
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_BoneCage.label: install bone rib cage
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_BoneCage.description: Grow another bone cage outside the ribs. Torso add-on, doesn't replace a part: torso max health +50%, sharp damage taken -20%. Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 600 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Remove_LP_Flesh_BoneCage.label: remove bone rib cage
LanguageData.LP_Remove_LP_Flesh_BoneCage.description: Take out the bone rib cage.
LanguageData.LP_Craft_BoneCage.label: grow bone rib cage
LanguageData.LP_Craft_BoneCage.description: Grow a bone rib cage from 600 fresh raw meat and 150 silver.
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_DeadEar.label: install ear of the dead's whispers
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_DeadEar.description: An ear that can hear the dead speak. Replaces one ear, part efficiency 125%; ability "Speak with dead": use on a humanlike corpse to learn 10% of the total XP of its highest skill (once per corpse; converted to adventurer XP as usual). Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 400 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_DeadEar.jobString: Installing an ear of the dead's whispers.
LanguageData.LP_Craft_DeadEar.label: grow ear of the dead's whispers
LanguageData.LP_Craft_DeadEar.description: Grow an ear of the dead's whispers from 400 fresh raw meat and 150 silver.
LanguageData.LP_Craft_DeadEar.jobString: Growing an ear of the dead's whispers.
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_SoulJaw.label: install soul-devouring jaw
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Flesh_SoulJaw.description: A jaw full of sharp teeth. Replaces the jaw, part efficiency 120%; adds a melee bite (14 damage); biting a living fleshy creature to death with it restores 10% psyfocus. Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 600 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Craft_SoulJaw.label: grow soul-devouring jaw
LanguageData.LP_Craft_SoulJaw.description: Grow a soul-devouring jaw from 600 fresh raw meat and 150 silver.
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_BeholderEye.label: install beholder eye
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_BeholderEye.descript: An eye taken from a beholder, still rolling when grafted into a socket. Replaces one eye, part efficiency 110%; ability "Beholder ray" (20 cells, cooldown 1 day): randomly set on installation to necrotic ray (30 necrotic damage), petrification ray (begins petrification) or charm ray (dazed 25 seconds). Side effects: own mood -5 (aberrant gaze), others' opinion of you -10. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Grow_Graft_BeholderEye.label: culture beholder eye
LanguageData.LP_Grow_Graft_BeholderEye.description: Culture a beholder eye from monster materials at the alchemy table (grafts can only be installed in the living).
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_DemonArm.label: install demon arm
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_DemonArm.description: An arm grown steeped in demon blood, with firelight under the skin. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 130%; melee hits add 5 fire damage. Side effects: 1% chance per day of a berserk rage break; can't be installed in celestial bloodlines (aasimar, celestial pact races). Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Grow_Graft_DemonArm.label: culture demon arm
LanguageData.LP_Grow_Graft_DemonArm.description: Culture a demon arm from monster materials at the alchemy table (grafts can only be installed in the living).
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_TrollGland.label: install troll regeneration gland
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_TrollGland.descripti: A troll's regeneration gland, sewn onto the torso. Torso add-on: natural wound healing ×3; regrows one missing small part every 15 days. Side effects: hunger rate +50%; regeneration stops for 12 hours after taking fire or acid damage. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Remove_LP_Graft_TrollGland.label: remove troll regeneration gland
LanguageData.LP_Remove_LP_Graft_TrollGland.descriptio: Take out the troll regeneration gland.
LanguageData.LP_Grow_Graft_TrollGland.label: culture troll regeneration gland
LanguageData.LP_Grow_Graft_TrollGland.description: Culture a troll regeneration gland from monster materials at the alchemy table (grafts can only be installed in the living).
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_ScaleRed.label: install red dragonscale subdermal armor
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Graft_ScaleRed.description: Red dragon scales embedded under the skin. Torso add-on: sharp armor +15%, fire damage -50%, cold damage +20%. LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Vecna_Hand.label: install Hand of Vecna
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Vecna_Hand.description: The left hand of the lich-god Vecna, cut off by his betrayer, withered and black yet still moving. Replaces the left hand (your own left hand must be amputated first), part efficiency 150%; adventurer Strength at least 20; abilities "Frost touch" (touch, 30 cold damage and lowers temperature, cooldown 10 seconds) and "Command undead" (one enemy undead within 20 cells fights for you for 30 seconds, cooldown 1 day). Curse: every 60 days a 10% chance of an "evil will" murderous rage (halved for liches). Artifact tier, takes 1 attunement slot; can't stack with lich limb reinforcement. Removing it drops the artifact on the ground, and the host gets mood -15 for 30 days. When both pieces are installed in the same person, "Will of Vecna" triggers: command capacity +50%, and for a lich with an undead body, phylactery revival shortens from 3 days to 1, but Kas the Betrayer comes calling with the Sword of Kas (first after 3-7 days, then every 30 days). Only one of each exists in the world: very rarely given by legendary adventure board commissions and mythal guardians past floor 60.
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Vecna_Eye.label: install Eye of Vecna
LanguageData.LP_Install_LP_Vecna_Eye.description: Vecna's gouged-out left eye, like a dark red gem. Replaces the left eye, part efficiency 150%; sees normally in darkness (no light penalty); ability "Dominate person" (like a mind flayer's domination: only attacks its former companions for 30 seconds, cooldown 1 day). Curse: own mood -8 (Vecna's gaze), others' opinion of you -20. Artifact tier, takes 1 attunement slot; can't stack with lich limb reinforcement. Removing it drops the artifact on the ground, and the host gets mood -15 for 30 days. When both pieces are installed in the same person, "Will of Vecna" triggers: command capacity +50%, and for a lich with an undead body, phylactery revival shortens from 3 days to 1, but Kas the Betrayer comes calling with the Sword of Kas (first after 3-7 days, then every 30 days). Only one of each exists in the world: very rarely given by legendary adventure board commissions and mythal guardians past floor 60.
